responsibility: Enumerates the SiFive custom vector intrinsic families in declarative form for the RVV builtin generator. Each `DEF_RVV_FUNCTION` entry ties a SiFive builtin name to a function base, shape, predication set, operand/type family, and required extension subset, supplying the intrinsic inventory for SiFive-specific vector builtins rather than implementing naming or expansion behavior directly.
